node.statement: Assuming the coordinate identities in node 1.3.1, rectangular multiplication gives Y^dagger dot V=sum_i Y_i^dagger dot V_i=sum_i(<Y_i,V_i>*u_Q). Because scalar multiplication of u_Q is additive over the finite scalar sum, this is exactly (sum_i<Y_i,V_i>)*u_Q. No occurrence of the amplified form <Y,V>_n has been introduced in this derivation.
